profile.positioning: As Chief Operating Officer at DiagnostAI, I’m leading the operational scaling of a groundbreaking platform leveraging artificial intelligence to revolutionize early disease detection. Our mission is to move beyond reactive healthcare to proactive, preventative care, improving patient outcomes and reducing systemic costs. In the last year, we’ve achieved significant traction, securing Series A funding and initiating pilot programs with three major hospital networks. My focus is on streamlining our go-to-market strategy, building robust partnerships, and ensuring regulatory compliance as we prepare for broader commercial launch. Prior to DiagnostAI, I spent over two decades in the pharmaceutical industry, holding leadership positions at Pfizer and Novartis. I’m particularly passionate about identifying and nurturing innovative companies at the intersection of healthcare and technology, and I’m always open to discussing potential synergies. I’m a firm believer that the future of healthcare is data-driven, and I'm looking to connect with individuals who share that vision and can contribute to building a healthier future.
